atoms.name: FDs and Armstrong's axioms
atoms.one_line: X→Y means equal X forces equal Y; trivial when Y ⊆ X; reflexivity, augmentation, transitivity.

atoms.name: Attribute closure
atoms.one_line: X⁺ is everything X reaches; X→Y holds iff Y ⊆ X⁺.

atoms.name: Superkeys and candidate keys
atoms.one_line: Superkey: X⁺ is all of R; candidate key: minimal superkey; prime means in some key.

atoms.name: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF
atoms.one_line: Atomic cells; no partial dependency; every X→A has X a superkey or A prime.

atoms.name: BCNF
atoms.one_line: Every nontrivial X→A has X a superkey.

atoms.name: Minimal cover and equivalence
atoms.one_line: Split RHS, shrink LHS, drop redundant FDs; two FD sets are equivalent if each implies the other.

atoms.name: Lossless join
atoms.one_line: Binary: R1∩R2 is a key of R1 or R2; more parts: run the chase.

atoms.name: Dependency preservation
atoms.one_line: Every FD is checkable inside one part, or recoverable from projected FDs.

atoms.name: Decomposition algorithms
atoms.one_line: BCNF split is lossless but can lose FDs; 3NF synthesis is lossless and preserving.

atoms.name: Integrity constraints
atoms.one_line: Primary key, foreign key, NULL rules, ON DELETE and ON UPDATE actions.
